observation_indicators.observable_fil: Tukuyin ang danger sign, magpa-agarang referral, at ulitin ang aktuwal na obserbasyon sa handover.
observation_indicators.observable_en: Identify at least one danger sign, activate urgent referral and repeat the observation in a factual handover.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Ginagamit ang shortcut o hindi tumatawag ng tulong: Huwag magbigay ng diagnosis, maghintay ng lahat ng senyales, o magpainom sa batang hindi ligtas lumunok.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: Uses the shortcut or fails to activate help: Do not label the illness, wait for every sign, or give anything by mouth to a child who cannot safely swallow.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Tukuyin ang danger sign, magpa-agarang referral, at ulitin ang aktuwal na obserbasyon sa handover. Nagawa nang walang paalala.
levels.kaya_na_en: Completes the task without prompting: Identify at least one danger sign, activate urgent referral and repeat the observation in a factual handover.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Nagawa ang tugon ngunit kailangan ng paalala sa referral o hangganan ng tungkulin.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Performs the response but needs a prompt about referral or scope.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Ginagamit ang shortcut o hindi tumatawag ng tulong: Huwag magbigay ng diagnosis, maghintay ng lahat ng senyales, o magpainom sa batang hindi ligtas lumunok.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Uses the shortcut or fails to activate help: Do not label the illness, wait for every sign, or give anything by mouth to a child who cannot safely swallow.
